kjv: Let your moderation be known unto all men
mine: Let your reasonableness be known to everyone
note: epieikes is gentleness, forbearance, a yielding spirit; "moderation" now suggests restraint in consumption.

kjv: I can do all things through Christ which strengtheneth me
mine: I can do all things through Him Who strengthens me
note: TR adds "Christo"; absent from Sinaiticus*, A, B, D*. And in context (4:11–12) "all things" means enduring plenty and want, not unlimited achievement.
